question.text: A Cat III AIF structured as a Company pays income tax at:

answer.text: Rates applicable to a Company (e.g., 25%/22% with conditions)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 115UB(4), Cat III AIFs formed as Company or LLP pay tax at rates applicable to that legal entity (corporate tax). The Trap: MMR is for Trust; pass-through doesn't apply; zero is wrong. Cross-Exam Context: Legal structure drives effective tax rate. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Compare effective tax rate across Trust/Company/LLP structures when advising fund sponsors.
